useWhen: Need to interact with websites programmatically
Filling forms, clicking buttons, automating browser tasks
Taking screenshots or extracting data from web pages
Login to sites or browser automation tasks

workflow.description: Open target URL using agent-browser open <url>
Get interactive element refs using agent-browser snapshot -i
Use element refs (@e1, @e2) to click, fill, select
After navigation or DOM changes, get fresh refs for continued interaction

examples.input: Login to github.com and check repository settings
examples.output: Automated browser session with credential authentication, navigation, and page interaction
examples.context: Need to access and interact with authenticated web application

examples.input: Scrape product data from an e-commerce site
examples.output: Extracted product information with screenshots and structured data output
examples.context: Data extraction from dynamic web pages
